notes: Berkeley Fair Workweek Ordinance, operational Jan. 12, 2024 (city FAQ rev. 08/23/24): covers retail employers with 56+ employees globally (franchisees and nonprofits: 100+); employees working 2+ hours/week in Berkeley.

Predictability pay: 1 hour for any change with <14 days but >=24 h notice; for cuts/cancellations with <24 h notice, 4 hours or the hours cut, whichever is less (extra key change_premium_hours_under_24h=4); additions with <24 h notice 1 hour.
Right to rest: may decline hours <11 h after the previous shift; 1.5x for each such hour worked.

rules.summary: Retail employers with 56+ employees globally must give 14 days' schedule notice and pay predictability pay for later changes.

citation.title: City of Berkeley — Fair Workweek FAQ (Rev. 08.23.24)
citation.excerpt: Covered Employers should provide Covered Employees with at least two weeks (14 days) of advanced notice of their work schedules.

rules.summary: Hours worked less than 11 hours after the previous shift are paid at 1.5x, and the employee may decline them.

citation.title: City of Berkeley — Fair Workweek FAQ (Rev. 08.23.24)
citation.excerpt: For every hour worked less than 11 hours after the end of the previous shift, an employee should be paid time and a half.

rules.summary: Berkeley's minimum wage is $19.61 an hour from July 1, 2026.
